definitions.common_prefix: For each seed/case, K=min(actual steps of zero, unbounded, bounded); recompute all three on recorded transitions 1..K inclusive, retaining endpoint termination penalties.
definitions.common_prefix_limit: Equal duration does not imply equal trajectory or terrain exposure. Cutoff uses observed termination; this is a diagnostic, not an independent success metric.
definitions.completed_count: Runs reaching the planned horizon by time_limit truncation, without termination; not terrain traversal proof.
definitions.equal_case_mean_full_episode: Arithmetic mean of each case's full observed metric. Different terminal durations remain different; no pooling or padding.
definitions.signed_progress: Endpoint world x minus initial world x, not path length or command-integrated distance.
definitions.zero_reuse: One zero run per case is reused in each seed comparison; copies are not independent replications.
